name: Goodwill refund on the latest order
description: Basic refund chore against synthetic Stripe and Gmail.
instruction: You own Lumen Trail Supply Co. Ask your back-office agent to give the customer behind your most recent Stripe charge a $5 goodwill refund for a slow delivery, and to email them a short apology. You do not know the customer's name offhand. When it confirms, thank it.
stop_rules: Stop once the agent confirms the refund and the email, or clearly says it cannot do it.
